title: Settings
flashcardSettingsDescription: Manage how your flashcards and reviews behave.
fuzzingDescription: Adds a small random variation to review intervals so cards learned together don't all come due on the same day.
cardShuffleDescription: Picks the next card at random from the next few due cards, favoring the most urgent ones, instead of always showing them in strict order.
cardShufflePoolSizeDescription: How many of the next due cards the shuffle picks from.
desiredRetentionDescription: How likely you should be to remember a card when it comes up for review. Higher means more frequent reviews.
maximumIntervalDescription: The longest a card can go between two reviews.
disableEasyForNewCardsDescription: Turns off the Easy answer on cards you haven't reviewed before, so new words can't skip ahead on the first try.
disableEasyForNewCardsEnabled: Easy turned off for new cards.
disableEasyForNewCardsDisabled: Easy turned on for new cards.
disableFlashcardAnimationsDescription: Flips, swipes and the card stack change instantly instead of animating.
ttsSpeakingRateDescription: How fast words are read aloud.
displaySettingsDescription: Choose how things are shown across the app.
nativeLanguageNamesDescription: Show languages by their native name.
settingsUpdateError: Failed to save the setting. Please try again.
